item.title: I am enduring a cornucopia of trauma with humour intact
item.description: ‘Pick up the hammer and nail this coffin shut!’ – Moira Rose, Schitt’s Creek. The post I am enduring a cornucopia of trauma with humour intact appeared first on Medical Republic.

item.title: Colleges unite to tell SA pollies what’s what
item.description: The South Australian branches of 10 specialist medical college have come together to set the agenda for the state’s healthcare system. The post Colleges unite to tell SA pollies what’s what appeared first on Medical Republic.

item.title: Government moves to expose non-GP specialist fees
item.description: Specialists will be obliged to post their fees on the Medical Costs Finder website, and product phoenixing will be outlawed by the new bill introduced today. The post Government moves to expose non-GP specialist fees appeared first on Medical Republic.

item.title: Here’s the average BB PIP payout
item.description: GP clinics which signed up to the government’s new bulk billing practice incentive will have received their first payment under the program over the last few weeks. The post Here’s the average BB PIP payout appeared first on Medical Republic.

item.title: 46-year-old female with iron deficiency anaemia due to HMB
item.description: Dr Renee Eslick, Haematologist presents the case of a 46-year-old female with iron deficiency anaemia secondary to heavy menstrual bleeding, with a focus on the most appropriate strategies to correct the iron deficiency. The post 46-year-old female with iron deficiency anaemia due to HMB appeared first on Medical Republic.

item.title: Becoming a healthcare candidate
item.description: GPs help candidates by becoming campaign managers, “selling patients”. Horrible term, common requirement. The post Becoming a healthcare candidate appeared first on Medical Republic.

item.title: Setting healthy boundaries in general practice
item.description: Listen to why protecting your own sustainability is essential for long term patient care. The post Setting healthy boundaries in general practice appeared first on Medical Republic.

item.title: 85% of fast-track specialists are GPs
item.description: The number of new doctors registering to practice is up by 50% on pre-pandemic numbers, health minister Mark Butler says. The post 85% of fast-track specialists are GPs appeared first on Medical Republic.

item.title: Government mulls unprecedented move on GP referrals
item.description: A new Department of Health, Disability and Ageing consultation suggests mandating that all medical referrals contain a pointer to the Medical Costs Finder website. The post Government mulls unprecedented move on GP referrals appeared first on Medical Republic.

item.title: DVA gives ‘once off reset’ to GP items
item.description: As part of new funding commitments, the Department of Veterans’ Affairs has also updated GP recognition in veteran compensation assessments. The post DVA gives ‘once off reset’ to GP items appeared first on Medical Republic.
